boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Colgate University
boards.description: Late-night dining at Colgate University is defined by a mix of on-campus staples and village favorites in Hamilton. From the legendary 'Slices' to 24/7 automated kiosks, these spots provide essential fuel for late-night study sessions and social gatherings.

cards.title: The Legendary Slices Run
cards.subtitle: 39 Lebanon St, Hamilton
cards.notes: Order a plain slice at this Hamilton institution, a cornerstone of late-night culture for generations of Colgate students.
cards.short_summary: Known universally as 'Slices,' this pizzeria is the definitive late-night destination in the village of Hamilton.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Pizzeria (Slices) is open until 2:00 a.m. on Monday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.
cards.source_title: New York Pizzeria (Slices) - The Colgate Maroon-News
cards.access_notes: Open until 2:00 a.m. most nights; delivery is available after 8:00 p.m.

cards.title: Midnight at Frank
cards.subtitle: 13 Oak Drive, Hamilton
cards.notes: Visit the primary campus dining hall for late-night snacks and social breaks before the midnight closing time.
cards.short_summary: The Curtiss E. Frank Dining Hall serves as the central hub for student dining and late-night social interaction on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Frank Dining Hall is open from 6:30 a.m. to midnight during the week.
cards.source_title: Colgate's Dining Staff: The Heart Behind Colgate's Dining Halls - The Colgate Maroon-News
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight daily during the academic semester.

cards.title: Late-Night Boost at The Coop
cards.subtitle: 13 Oak Drive, Hamilton
cards.notes: Use the Boost app to order grill items and snacks for pickup during the dedicated late-night window.
cards.short_summary: The Coop offers a specialized late-night menu for students seeking quick bites in the center of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Late-night dining at the Coop is available from 8:00 p.m. to midnight daily via the Boost mobile app.
cards.access_notes: Late-night service runs from 8:00 p.m. to midnight.

cards.title: 24/7 Warm Food Kiosk
cards.subtitle: O'Connor Campus Center
cards.notes: Grab a warm White Castle burger or Cinnabon roll anytime from this automated vending machine in the Coop.
cards.short_summary: An automated 'Just Baked' kiosk provides 24/7 access to warm snacks, filling the gap after dining halls close.
cards.evidence_claim: An automated vending machine called Just Baked provides constant access to warm food in the O'Connor Campus Center.
cards.source_title: Dining Services Makes Student-Centered Changes for Fall 2024 - The Colgate Maroon-News
cards.access_notes: Available 24/7 inside the O'Connor Campus Center.

cards.title: Library Study Fuel
cards.subtitle: Level 5, Case-Geyer Library
cards.notes: Access the 5th-floor café area for vending machine snacks and a 24/7 study environment during finals.
cards.short_summary: The Case-Geyer Library Café offers a 24/7 space for students to study and access vending machine refreshments.
cards.evidence_claim: Case-Geyer provides 24/7 study spaces on Level 5 in the Café with food and beverage machines.
cards.source_title: After Hours Access to Case-Geyer - Colgate University Libraries
cards.access_notes: 24/7 access to the Level 5 Café area with a valid student ID card.

cards.title: Fridays at Donnie's
cards.subtitle: Hall of Presidents
cards.notes: Enjoy late-night programming and pub fare at this campus social hub, which extends hours for weekend events.
cards.short_summary: Donovan's Pub, or 'Donnie's,' is a popular campus spot that hosts late-night events and offers a relaxed dining atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: Donovan's Pub has extended hours for 'Fridays@Donnie's' events, running from 11:00 p.m. to 1:00 a.m.
cards.source_title: Donovan's Pub Extends Hours and Adds Events - The Colgate Maroon-News
cards.access_notes: Extended hours until 1:00 a.m. on select Friday nights for student events.

cards.title: The Stewart's Ice Cream Run
cards.subtitle: 2463 New York 12B, Hamilton
cards.notes: Head to Stewart's for a late-night pint of ice cream or a quick hot meal from the grab-and-go section.
cards.short_summary: A regional favorite, Stewart's Shops provides essential late-night convenience and ice cream for the Hamilton community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Stewart's Shops location in Hamilton is open until 11:00 p.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Convenience Store and Gas Station in Hamilton | Stewart's Shops
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 5:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m.

cards.title: Byrne Dairy Deli Run
cards.subtitle: 169 Utica St, Hamilton
cards.notes: Stop by for a late-night sandwich or a slice of breakfast pizza at this local deli and convenience store.
cards.short_summary: Byrne Dairy is a go-to for students seeking deli sandwiches and grocery essentials late into the evening.
cards.evidence_claim: Byrne Dairy & Deli in Hamilton offers online ordering for pickup until 9:40 p.m.
cards.source_title: Byrne Dairy & Deli 169 Utica St - Order Online
cards.access_notes: Open late for pickup and convenience items; check seasonal hours for midnight closing.

cards.title: Late Dinner at Royal India
cards.subtitle: 6 Broad St, Hamilton
cards.notes: Enjoy a late-night Indian feast with friends at this popular village spot, open until 10:00 p.m. on weekends.
cards.short_summary: Royal India Grill offers a flavorful alternative for students looking for a sit-down meal later in the evening.
cards.evidence_claim: Royal India Grill is open until 10:00 p.m. on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:00 p.m. on Friday and Saturday; 9:00 p.m. other nights.

cards.title: The Village Subway Run
cards.subtitle: 34 Utica St, Hamilton
cards.notes: Grab a late-night sub sandwich in the village, a reliable option for students after campus dining closes.
cards.short_summary: Located conveniently in the village, Subway provides a familiar late-night sandwich option for the Colgate community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Subway location at 34 Utica St in Hamilton is open until 9:30 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Open until 9:30 p.m. daily.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Discover the specific study nooks, quiet retreats, and social hubs that Colgate students use to navigate their daily academic life beyond the standard tour stops.

cards.title: The Level 5 Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Case Library and Geyer Center for Information Technology
cards.notes: Head to the fifth floor past the Chobani Cafe for a 24-hour quiet zone with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking Payne Brook and the village.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour quiet study space on the top floor of Case Library featuring expansive views and a mix of large tables and comfortable lounge seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The Reading Room on level 5 of Case Library is open 24 hours and features large windows with views of Payne Brook.
cards.source_title: Top Five Best Study Spots on Campus
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for students with keycard access after regular building hours.

cards.title: The Glass Bridge at Persson
cards.subtitle: Persson Hall
cards.notes: Study in the glass-enclosed lounge connecting the two wings of Persson Hall, offering views of Taylor Lake and the lower campus.
cards.short_summary: A scenic glass-walled bridge lounge that serves as a popular study spot and architectural connector between the upper and lower campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Persson Hall features a glass bridge on the second level with floor-to-ceiling windows and tables for individual and group work.
cards.access_notes: Accessible during academic building hours; features round tables and long work surfaces.

cards.title: Ho Science Center Atrium
cards.subtitle: Robert H.N. Ho Science Center
cards.notes: Utilize the open atrium and small end-of-hallway study areas for collaborative work under high ceilings and natural light.
cards.short_summary: A bright, multi-level atrium in the science center known for its open floor plan and glass railings, popular for group projects.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ho Science Center offers public access study spaces in the atrium area and small end-of-hallway study areas.
cards.access_notes: Available when not in use for faculty or staff events; typically open during building hours.

cards.title: Chapel House Retreat
cards.subtitle: Chapel House
cards.notes: Visit this quiet retreat at the edge of the forest for silent study or meditation in the 24-hour Meditation Hall.
cards.short_summary: A secluded interfaith center offering a library of 4,000 books on spirituality, a music room, and a 24-hour meditation space.
cards.evidence_claim: The Meditation Hall at Chapel House is open 24 hours a day for use at any time for students and visitors.
cards.access_notes: The Meditation Hall is open 24/7; the library and music room have standard daytime hours.

cards.title: ALANA Center Lounge
cards.subtitle: ALANA Cultural Center
cards.notes: A welcoming community space for social gathering and group study, featuring a library and multicultural resources.
cards.short_summary: A hub for multicultural exploration and social justice education that provides a comfortable lounge for student gathering and study.
cards.evidence_claim: The ALANA Cultural Center lounge is available for group study and social gathering, with hours until 9 p.m. on weekends.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday 8 a.m. - 9 p.m. and Saturday-Sunday 4 p.m. - 9 p.m.

cards.title: Lathrop Hall Lobby
cards.subtitle: Lathrop Hall
cards.notes: The renovated lobby offers an open, inviting space for collaboration near the Writing and Speaking Center.
cards.short_summary: A modern, light-filled lobby in one of Colgate's oldest buildings, redesigned to facilitate student collaboration and informal study.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lathrop Hall renovation created a transformed, wide-open lobby that allows for open collaboration and use of technology.
cards.source_title: Lathrop Hall, built in 1905, undergoes major makeover
cards.access_notes: Accessible during academic building hours; located on the main floor.

cards.title: Cooley Science Library
cards.subtitle: McGregory Hall
cards.notes: Located in the middle of the academic quad, this library offers a quiet environment with carrels and desktop computers.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated science library in McGregory Hall known for its quiet atmosphere and convenient location for students between classes.
cards.evidence_claim: Cooley Science Library in McGregory Hall features study tables, carrels, and is generally a quiet space for individual study.
cards.access_notes: Open until 2 a.m. most nights; food is not permitted in this library.

cards.title: Casual Study at The Coop
cards.subtitle: O'Connor Campus Center
cards.notes: Join the 'Coop lock-in' for casual homework in a social environment with background noise and easy access to food.
cards.short_summary: The central student union hub where students often engage in 'casual homework' amidst the social buzz of the dining area.
cards.evidence_claim: Students use the O'Connor Campus Center (the Coop) for productive casual homework and 'Coop lock-ins'.
cards.source_title: The Coop: A Dining Room, a Computer Lab and a Place to Study
cards.access_notes: Open late; particularly busy during lunch hours but offers computer labs and lounges for study.

cards.title: Olin Hall Breakout Rooms
cards.subtitle: Olin Hall
cards.notes: Utilize the modern breakout rooms for collaborative group study sessions in a building known for its natural light.
cards.short_summary: Modern academic building featuring breakout rooms designed for group collaboration and peer-to-peer learning.
cards.evidence_claim: Olin Hall has breakout rooms that are useful for studying with a group of peers in a collaborative atmosphere.
cards.source_title: Top Five Best Study Spots on Campus
cards.access_notes: Accessible during academic building hours; popular for its modern facilities.

cards.title: Seven Oaks Clubhouse
cards.subtitle: Seven Oaks Golf Club
cards.notes: Walk down to the clubhouse for a meal with views of the course; a quiet alternative to campus dining halls.
cards.short_summary: The clubhouse of Colgate's award-winning golf course, offering a full restaurant and a relaxing space for students to gather.
cards.evidence_claim: The Seven Oaks Clubhouse features a full restaurant and is a place to relax with friends and enjoy views of the course.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public and students; walking is required for students on the course, but the clubhouse is accessible by road.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Explore the best of Colgate University without spending a dime, from world-class art galleries and specialized museums to serene nature trails and quiet meditation spaces.

cards.title: Picker Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Dana Arts Center
cards.notes: Visit the second floor of the Dana Arts Center to view a collection of 11,000 objects, including 20th-century photography and modern paintings.
cards.short_summary: Colgate's primary art museum featuring a vast collection of global works and rotating exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday–Friday 10 a.m.–5 p.m., Saturday–Sunday 12 p.m.–5 p.m.

cards.title: Longyear Museum of Anthropology
cards.subtitle: Alumni Hall
cards.notes: Head to the second floor of Alumni Hall to explore archaeological and ethnological materials from Africa, Oceania, and the Americas.
cards.short_summary: A museum dedicated to global cultural heritage and student-curated anthropological exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum is free and open to the public during the academic semester.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday–Friday 9:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m. during the academic year.

cards.title: Robert M. Linsley Geology Museum
cards.subtitle: Robert H.N. Ho Science Center
cards.notes: Examine rare minerals, fossils, and rock specimens that highlight the geological history of the Earth and the local region.
cards.short_summary: A science-focused museum showcasing geological wonders and research-grade specimens.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday–Friday 9:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m.

cards.title: Public Planetarium Screenings
cards.subtitle: Ho Science Center 4th Floor
cards.notes: Attend a free public screening in this 55-seat digital theater to see immersive shows about space, history, and the universe.
cards.short_summary: A state-of-the-art digital dome theater offering free educational shows to the community.
cards.evidence_claim: The visualization lab is open for free public screenings.
cards.source_title: Visualization lab offers free 'out-of-world' experiences | Colgate University
cards.access_notes: Check the university calendar for specific public screening times.

cards.title: Chapel House Meditation Hall
cards.subtitle: Alumni Road
cards.notes: Use the Meditation Hall for silent reflection or join guided sessions; the space is designed for quietude and spiritual exploration.
cards.short_summary: A secluded sanctuary on campus offering a library, meditation garden, and silent hall for all visitors.
cards.evidence_claim: The Meditation Hall is open 24 hours a day, every day, for use at any time.
cards.access_notes: The Meditation Hall is accessible 24/7; other areas have specific daytime hours.

cards.entity_name: Harry H. Lang Cross Country Course
cards.title: Harry Lang Trails
cards.subtitle: Near Alumni Road
cards.notes: Hike or run on the 5K and 8K trails that wind through the woods and offer scenic overlooks of the campus and athletics facilities.
cards.short_summary: A network of impeccably maintained trails used for running, skiing, and mindfulness.
cards.evidence_claim: The trails offer a unique opportunity for students and community members to enjoy the beauty of Colgate's surrounding forests.
cards.source_title: Finding Your Way to the Harry Lang Trails - The Colgate Maroon-News
cards.access_notes: Open year-round for hiking and running; cross-country skiing in winter.

cards.title: Willow Path & Taylor Lake
cards.subtitle: Lower Campus
cards.notes: Walk the iconic tree-lined path along Taylor Lake, a central campus landmark perfect for a quiet stroll or bird watching.
cards.short_summary: A historic and picturesque walkway that serves as one of Colgate's most beloved landmarks.
cards.evidence_claim: The lake and the picturesque tree-lined walkway are landmark sites of memories and traditions in the community.
cards.source_title: Beloved landmarks: Taylor Lake and the Willow Path | Colgate at 200 Years
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor area open 24/7.

cards.title: Colgate Free Store
cards.subtitle: Campus Location Varies
cards.notes: Browse and take up to five items per day, including clothing, school supplies, and small electronics, all donated by the community.
cards.short_summary: A sustainability initiative providing free essential goods to the student body.
cards.evidence_claim: All items are completely free for Colgate students.
cards.access_notes: Open year-round when class is in session; check official site for current hours.

cards.title: Case Library Reading Room
cards.subtitle: 13 Oak Drive
cards.notes: Utilize the silent reading rooms or the 24/7 study spaces on Level 5 for focused work or quiet relaxation.
cards.short_summary: The university's main library offering diverse study environments and extensive digital resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Case-Geyer provides 24/7 study spaces on Level 5 by using your keycard ID.
cards.source_title: After Hours Access to Case-Geyer - Colgate University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Level 5 study spaces are available 24/7 for students with ID.

cards.title: ALANA Cultural Center
cards.subtitle: Near the Coop
cards.notes: Drop by for multicultural exploration, social justice education, or to attend one of the many free community-building events.
cards.short_summary: A hub for celebrating diversity and fostering inclusivity through programming and social spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The center honors rich cultural expression and serves as a sponsor for numerous signature events.
cards.access_notes: Open to all students, staff, and faculty during standard campus hours.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: From the pin-drop silence of the library's fourth floor to the sun-drenched glass bridge at Persson Hall, these ten campus environments offer distinct settings for focused academic work.

cards.title: Pin-Drop Silence on Level 4
cards.subtitle: Case Library and Geyer Center
cards.notes: Utilize the individual cubicles on the fourth floor for deep focus. This level is strictly designated for quiet study with minimal distractions.
cards.short_summary: The fourth floor of Case Library is the university's primary destination for students requiring absolute silence and individual workstations.
cards.evidence_claim: Case-Geyer Library is the majority of Colgate University students' tried and true study location. Each floor offers a different atmosphere, from those who prefer the pin-drop silence of the fourth floor.
cards.source_title: No Spot Is Just Right: From Quiet Libraries to Athlete-Friendly Spaces - The Colgate Maroon-News
cards.access_notes: Open during regular library hours; Level 5 remains accessible 24/7 via keycard.

cards.title: The Glass Bridge at Persson
cards.subtitle: Persson Hall
cards.notes: Study at the round tables or the long individual desk on the glass bridge. Enjoy floor-to-ceiling windows with views of Hamilton and the lower campus.
cards.short_summary: A scenic glass-enclosed bridge connecting the two wings of Persson Hall, featuring natural light and panoramic views.
cards.evidence_claim: Persson Hall is a stunning pair of buildings connected by a glass bridge on the second level. Here, you can find floor-to-ceiling windows, plants, round tables with multiple seats, and one long table for individual work.
cards.source_title: Top Five Best Study Spots on Campus
cards.access_notes: Public access study spaces typically available 7 AM to 2 AM on weekdays.

cards.title: Sunlight in the Ho Atrium
cards.subtitle: Robert H.N. Ho Science Center
cards.notes: Find a spot in the open atrium or the small end-of-hallway study areas. The high ceilings and glass railings create an airy, collaborative environment.
cards.short_summary: The Ho Science Center offers modern, light-filled study areas and group rooms within its 121,000-square-foot interdisciplinary facility.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ho Science Center is a pristine space that has many places to set up shop with your books. There are glass railings and high ceilings that many students enjoy with the open floor plan.
cards.source_title: Top Five Best Study Spots on Campus
cards.access_notes: Public access study spaces and atrium open Mon-Fri 7 AM-2 AM, Sat-Sun 10 AM-2 AM.

cards.title: Quiet Focus at Cooley
cards.subtitle: McGregory Hall
cards.notes: Use the study carrels or tables in McGregory Hall. This space is ideal for natural science and math students needing a quiet, book-filled environment.
cards.short_summary: Located in McGregory Hall, Cooley Science Library provides a specialized, quiet environment for STEM-focused research and study.
cards.evidence_claim: Located in McGregory Hall, Cooley Science Library serves the natural sciences, mathematics, computer science, and psychology... It provides students with study spaces, course reserves and personal research assistance.
cards.access_notes: Open Mon-Fri 8 AM-2 AM, Sat-Sun 9 AM-2 AM during the academic year.

cards.title: Artistic Views in Little Hall
cards.subtitle: Little Hall
cards.notes: Head to the third-floor lounge for a quiet retreat. The large windows overlook Taylor Lake and Case Library, offering a peaceful backdrop for reading.
cards.short_summary: The third floor of Little Hall features a central lounge space with expansive windows, favored by art and art history students.
cards.evidence_claim: Sophomore year... I discovered the third floor of the building, with its lounge space in the center and sprawling windows that overlook Case Library and Taylor Lake.
cards.source_title: The Best Nest: Little Hall - The Colgate Maroon-News
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours; typically used by art history concentrators but open for quiet study.

cards.title: Community Study at ALANA
cards.subtitle: ALANA Cultural Center
cards.notes: Visit the lounge for a welcoming, community-oriented study environment. The space is designed for both social connection and academic focus.
cards.short_summary: The ALANA Cultural Center provides a multipurpose lounge and seminar rooms that serve as a learning and social space for the campus community.
cards.evidence_claim: The ALANA Cultural Center serves as a learning place, social space, and focal point where Colgate students, faculty, and staff gather... Lounge available Mon–Fri 8 AM–12 Midnight.
cards.access_notes: Open Mon-Fri 8 AM-9 PM, Sat-Sun 4 PM-9 PM; extended hours during finals.

cards.title: Downstairs Focus at the Coop
cards.subtitle: O'Connor Campus Center
cards.notes: Head to the lower level of the O'Connor Campus Center for a quieter alternative to the main dining area. The lab offers computer access and desk space.
cards.short_summary: Located in the basement of 'the Coop,' this computer lab provides a more secluded and quiet environment than the bustling main floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Head downstairs to find a room with computer access as well as a quiet and relatively empty location to study.
cards.source_title: Colgate's Hidden Gems: Spots to Study Outside of the Library - Her Campus
cards.access_notes: Computer Lab open Mon-Sun 10 AM-10 PM; building open 24/7 during finals.

cards.title: Cultural Quiet in Lawrence
cards.subtitle: Lawrence Hall
cards.notes: Study in the Japanese or Chinese styled alcoves. This lounge offers a unique, quiet atmosphere for reading and small group meetings.
cards.short_summary: The East Asian Lounge in Lawrence Hall features culturally themed rooms designed for quiet study and faculty-student interaction.
cards.evidence_claim: Opened in October 2018... the lounge features rooms decorated in both Japanese and Chinese styles for use as a quiet space to study, chat, or meet with professors.
cards.source_title: Facilities — East Asian Languages and Literatures - Colgate University
cards.access_notes: Humanities Lounge open Mon-Thu 6 PM-2 AM, Sat-Sun 10 AM-2 AM.

cards.title: Evening Study in Lathrop
cards.subtitle: Lathrop Hall
cards.notes: Utilize renovated classrooms like 207 or 308 for group work after hours. These spaces offer flexible seating and modern teaching technology.
cards.short_summary: Renovated in 2013, Lathrop Hall provides flexible multipurpose rooms and classrooms that become available for student study in the evenings.
cards.evidence_claim: Lathrop Hall... Classroom(s) 207, 308, 310, 314, 408, 410 (S) (when not in use for department related meetings and events). Mon–Thu 6 PM–2 AM.
cards.access_notes: Classrooms available for study Mon-Thu 6 PM-2 AM and weekends 10 AM-2 AM.

cards.title: 24/7 Access at the Café
cards.subtitle: Case Library and Geyer Center
cards.notes: Access the Level 5 Café and Flexible Work Room after hours using your keycard. This is the primary spot for late-night or early-morning cramming.
cards.short_summary: The Level 5 Café area provides a 24-hour study environment with vending machines and flexible seating for students with keycard access.
cards.evidence_claim: When the building is closed, Case-Geyer provides 24/7 study spaces on Level 5 in the Café... and Flexible Work Room by using your keycard ID for access.
cards.source_title: After Hours Access to Case-Geyer - Colgate University Libraries
cards.access_notes: 24/7 access via Level 5 entry with valid Colgate ID card.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Explore the village of Hamilton, a historic district just down the hill from campus where student life meets local commerce.

cards.title: Colgate Bookstore
cards.subtitle: Utica Street
cards.notes: Visit the largest independent bookstore in Central NY to find textbooks, university apparel, and school supplies in a historic three-story building.
cards.short_summary: The university's primary retail hub for textbooks and gear located in downtown Hamilton.
cards.evidence_claim: The Colgate Bookstore is located in a historic three-story building at 3 Utica Street in the heart of Hamilton, NY.
cards.access_notes: Open daily to the public; easily accessible via the Colgate Shuttle.

cards.title: Colgate Inn
cards.subtitle: Payne Street
cards.notes: Stop by this landmark hotel and restaurant facing the Village Green, often described as the front door to the university for visitors.
cards.short_summary: A historic hotel and dining establishment that serves as a central gathering point for the community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Colgate Inn is located at 1 Payne Street and is considered a landmark that serves as a front door to the University.
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible hotel and restaurant; dining hours vary by day.

cards.title: Hamilton Movie Theater
cards.subtitle: Lebanon Street
cards.notes: Catch a film or live performance at this independent theater that has served as a community centerpiece since 1895.
cards.short_summary: A historic independent cinema offering diverse film programming and community events.
cards.evidence_claim: Hamilton Theater, located at 7 Lebanon Street, has served as a centerpiece for films and community events since 1895.
cards.access_notes: Open for scheduled screenings and events; ticket purchase required for movies.

cards.title: The Hub
cards.subtitle: Lebanon Street
cards.notes: Work on your startup at this business incubator where students and local entrepreneurs collaborate in a creative workspace.
cards.short_summary: A New York State certified business incubator supporting student and regional entrepreneurship.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hub is located at 8 Lebanon Street and provides a community for entrepreneurs supported by Colgate's program.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–5 p.m.; 24/7 access available for authorized students via GateCard.

cards.title: Hamilton Whole Foods
cards.subtitle: Broad Street
cards.notes: Grab a healthy vegetarian lunch or browse organic groceries at this community-focused shop known for its sustainability practices.
cards.short_summary: A local grocery and cafe specializing in natural, organic, and vegetarian options.
cards.evidence_claim: Hamilton Whole Foods is located at 28 Broad Street and offers healthy, vegetarian lunches and organic inventory.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday 10am-5pm, Saturday 10am-4pm; closed Sundays.

cards.title: Flour & Salt
cards.subtitle: Lebanon Street
cards.notes: Order a signature bagel sandwich and coffee at this popular cafe that serves as a frequent study and social spot for students.
cards.short_summary: A local cafe and bakery famous for its bagel sandwiches and community atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: Flour & Salt operates a cafe at 37 Lebanon Street in downtown Hamilton.
cards.access_notes: Open daily for breakfast and lunch; check website for seasonal hours.

cards.title: Hamilton Eatery
cards.subtitle: Lebanon Street
cards.notes: Enjoy deli sandwiches and comfort food at this local favorite, known for its pot pies and casual dining environment.
cards.short_summary: A casual deli and restaurant offering a variety of sandwiches, burgers, and homemade pies.
cards.evidence_claim: Hamilton Eatery is located at 41 Lebanon Street and serves deli sandwiches, burgers, and more.
cards.access_notes: Open for lunch and dinner; popular for takeout and casual sit-down meals.

cards.title: Parry's
cards.subtitle: Utica Street
cards.notes: Find everything from hardware to general interest items at this long-standing local store that also offers dry cleaning services.
cards.short_summary: A versatile local hardware and general store serving the Hamilton community.
cards.evidence_claim: Parry's is located at 100 Utica Street and sells a variety of general interest items and hardware.
cards.source_title: Visitor and Guest Information | Colgate University
cards.access_notes: Open daily; provides essential supplies for students living off-campus.

cards.title: Village Green
cards.subtitle: Broad Street
cards.notes: Relax in this central park space that hosts community events, farmers markets, and serves as the heart of the historic district.
cards.short_summary: The central public park and historic common space of the village of Hamilton.
cards.evidence_claim: The Village Green offers a space for local eateries and merchants and is surrounded by historic homes.
cards.access_notes: Public park open 24/7; hosts the seasonal farmers market on Saturdays.

cards.title: Community Memorial Hospital
cards.subtitle: Broad Street
cards.notes: Access medical care and urgent care services at this facility located just north of the village center on the main corridor.
cards.short_summary: The primary healthcare provider and urgent care clinic for the Hamilton area.
cards.evidence_claim: Community Memorial Hospital is located at 150 Broad Street and includes an Urgent Care Clinic.
cards.source_title: Visitor and Guest Information | Colgate University
cards.access_notes: Hospital open 24/7; Urgent Care hours vary. Located approximately one mile from campus.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: From the lucky number 13 to the symbolic torchlight descent, Colgate University's traditions are deeply rooted in its 1817 founding and the unique geography of 'The Hill.'

cards.title: The Lucky Number 13
cards.subtitle: A founding legacy of 13 men, dollars, and prayers
cards.notes: Embrace the number 13, which appears in the zip code, campus speed limits, and the university address. It honors the 13 founders who started the school with $13 and 13 prayers.
cards.short_summary: Colgate's most pervasive tradition celebrates the number 13 as a symbol of good fortune rather than a superstition.
cards.evidence_claim: Colgate University was founded by 13 men with 13 dollars and 13 prayers; the number is now integrated into the campus speed limit (13 mph) and address (13 Oak Drive).
cards.access_notes: Visible campus-wide through signage and official university branding.

cards.title: Senior Torchlight Procession
cards.subtitle: The symbolic descent from the Hill
cards.notes: Join the graduating class on the eve of Commencement as they carry torches down the hill and through Willow Path, symbolizing the light of knowledge entering the world.
cards.short_summary: A century-old graduation rite where seniors process down the hill with lit torches to signify their transition to alumni status.
cards.evidence_claim: The Senior Torchlight Procession began in 1930 and involves graduates processing from the Academic Quad down to Taylor Lake on the night before graduation.
cards.access_notes: Held annually during Commencement Weekend; spectators are welcome at designated viewing areas.

cards.title: Colgate Day
cards.subtitle: Celebrating every Friday the 13th
cards.notes: Wear your best maroon gear whenever Friday falls on the 13th. This worldwide celebration connects students and alumni through social media and local campus events.
cards.short_summary: A recurring holiday celebrated by the Colgate community every time a Friday the 13th occurs on the calendar.
cards.evidence_claim: Colgate Day is an official university tradition celebrated every Friday the 13th, where the community wears maroon and participates in spirit events.
cards.access_notes: Occurs on every Friday the 13th; events are held on campus and in alumni chapters globally.

cards.title: The Willow Path Legend
cards.subtitle: A walk toward destiny
cards.notes: Walk the scenic path along Taylor Lake. Legend says that couples who have their first kiss on the Willow Path bridge are destined to marry.
cards.short_summary: A romantic campus superstition centered on the historic willow-lined walkway and its small bridge.
cards.evidence_claim: The Willow Path legend suggests that a first kiss on the path's bridge leads to marriage; the path itself was restored with 25 new willows in 1989.
cards.source_title: Beloved landmarks: Taylor Lake and the Willow Path | Colgate at 200 Years
cards.access_notes: Open to the public daily; the path runs along the north shore of Taylor Lake.

cards.title: Konosioni Torch Medals
cards.subtitle: Gratitude for the Colgate community
cards.notes: Seniors present these medals to faculty or staff who made a meaningful impact on their college journey, a tradition led by the Konosioni Senior Honor Society.
cards.short_summary: A senior-year tradition of expressing gratitude to mentors through the presentation of symbolic medals.
cards.evidence_claim: The Torch Medal tradition was inspired by the Konosioni Senior Honor Society to recognize the impact of faculty and staff on the student experience.
cards.access_notes: Medals are distributed to seniors during their final year for presentation to chosen mentors.

cards.title: The Colgate Hello
cards.subtitle: A century of campus friendliness
cards.notes: Keep the tradition alive by greeting fellow community members as you pass them on the Hill. This practice dates back to at least the 1920s.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing social custom encouraging students and faculty to greet one another while walking on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The 'Colgate Hello' was first mentioned in the 1924-25 Student Handbook and remains a promoted cultural practice on campus today.
cards.access_notes: An informal social tradition practiced daily across the entire campus.

cards.title: Founders' Day Convocation
cards.subtitle: Welcoming the first-year class
cards.notes: Attend this formal ceremony during orientation to mark your official entry into the academic community, featuring a procession and a keynote address.
cards.short_summary: The capstone orientation event that formally initiates new students into the university's history and values.
cards.evidence_claim: Founders' Day Convocation is the formal welcoming event for the first-year class, held at the end of orientation before fall classes begin.
cards.access_notes: Held annually in late August; primarily for first-year students and faculty.

cards.title: Room Return
cards.subtitle: Seniors revisiting their first-year roots
cards.notes: During Springfest, seniors visit their former first-year dorm rooms to meet current residents and share memories of their early days on the Hill.
cards.short_summary: A nostalgic tradition where graduating seniors return to their original residence halls to connect with underclassmen.
cards.evidence_claim: Room Return is a senior tradition held during Springfest where seniors revisit their first and second-year dorms to reminisce and meet current occupants.
cards.source_title: Springfest Weekend 2026 Boasts Jam-Packed Itinerary, New Traditions
cards.access_notes: Takes place in residence halls across campus during Springfest weekend.

cards.title: Old Colgate Spirit
cards.subtitle: The song of the thirteen men
cards.notes: Learn the lyrics to this iconic campus song that recounts the story of the 13 founders. It is often performed by the Colgate Thirteen a cappella group.
cards.short_summary: A traditional university song that immortalizes the story of the school's founding in 1819.
cards.evidence_claim: The song 'Old Colgate Spirit' includes lyrics about the 13 prayers and 13 dollars that founded the university and is a staple of campus events.
cards.access_notes: Performed at athletic events, convocations, and by student musical groups.

cards.title: The Numbered Boulders of Peter's Glen
cards.subtitle: A countdown in stone
cards.notes: Explore the staircase in Peter's Glen to find boulders engraved with numbers counting down from 13, a subtle nod to the university's favorite number.
cards.short_summary: A series of engraved boulders along a campus nature path that integrate the number 13 into the landscape.
cards.evidence_claim: Peter's Glen features a staircase with boulders engraved with descending numbers starting from 13 at the top.
cards.source_title: The Number 13: How We Can Count on Colgate
cards.access_notes: Accessible via the walking path near the ALANA Cultural Center.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Colgate University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A guide to the essential traditions and campus landmarks for new students during their first weekend on the hill.

cards.title: Arrive on the Hill
cards.subtitle: The official start of your journey
cards.notes: Pass the 'Honk If You Love Colgate' sign and head to Whitnall Field to unload. Volunteers will help you move into your Residential Commons.
cards.short_summary: The first official day for new students to move into residence halls and begin orientation.
cards.evidence_claim: Arrival Day for domestic students is Sunday, August 23, 2026, featuring the 'Honk If You Love Colgate' tradition and unloading at Whitnall Field.
cards.access_notes: Check-in begins in the morning; specific times are assigned by the university.

cards.title: First Meal at Frank
cards.subtitle: The social heart of campus dining
cards.notes: Grab your first meal with new roommates. Look for the omelet station, a student favorite, and enjoy the views from the hilltop windows.
cards.short_summary: The primary dining facility for first-year students, known for its social atmosphere and variety of food stations.
cards.evidence_claim: Frank Dining Hall is a central social hub for students and is open from 6:30 a.m. to midnight during the week.
cards.source_title: Colgate's Dining Staff: The Heart Behind Colgate's Dining Halls - The Colgate Maroon-News
cards.access_notes: Open daily; late-night dining typically resumes once the full semester begins.

cards.title: Gear Up Downtown
cards.subtitle: Three floors of books and apparel
cards.notes: Take the shuttle downtown to pick up your textbooks and a maroon sweatshirt. It is the largest independent bookstore in Central New York.
cards.short_summary: The university-owned bookstore located in downtown Hamilton, offering textbooks, apparel, and gifts.
cards.evidence_claim: The Colgate Bookstore is located at 3 Utica St. and is open Saturdays from 10:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Saturday; closed on Sundays.

cards.title: Stroll Willow Path
cards.subtitle: A scenic campus landmark
cards.notes: Walk along the edge of Taylor Lake on the historic Willow Path. It is a perfect spot for a quiet moment or a first-weekend photo.
cards.short_summary: A picturesque lake and tree-lined walkway on the lower campus, central to many university traditions.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor Lake and Willow Path are landmark sites for memories and traditions, created in the early 1900s for campus beautification.
cards.source_title: Beloved landmarks: Taylor Lake and the Willow Path | Colgate at 200 Years
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor space available 24/7.

cards.title: Celebrate at ALANA
cards.subtitle: A signature start-of-year event
cards.notes: Join the ALANA Cultural Center for food, music, and community building. It is a key event for meeting students from all backgrounds.
cards.short_summary: An annual celebration hosted by the ALANA Cultural Center to welcome students at the start of the academic year.
cards.evidence_claim: ALANA Palooza is a signature event at the beginning of each academic year for connecting and celebrating the community.
cards.source_title: ALANA Cultural Programs and Initiatives | Colgate University
cards.access_notes: Typically held during the first week or weekend of the fall semester.

cards.title: Visit the Trudy Center
cards.subtitle: Sustainable wellness on two floors
cards.notes: Check out the LEED Gold-certified gym. Use the cardio machines upstairs or weights downstairs to stay active between orientation sessions.
cards.short_summary: The university's primary fitness facility, featuring modern equipment and sustainable design.
cards.evidence_claim: The Trudy Fitness Center is free for all Colgate students and was the university's first LEED-certified facility.
cards.access_notes: Requires a valid Colgate ID for entry; hours vary by season.

cards.title: Explore the Village Green
cards.subtitle: The heart of the Hamilton community
cards.notes: Walk down the hill to the center of town. The Green hosts community events and is surrounded by local shops and cafes.
cards.short_summary: A central park in the Village of Hamilton that serves as a gathering place for students and residents.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hamilton Village Green is located at 1-13 Broad St. and hosts events like the Colgate Day of Service and local festivals.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public year-round.

cards.title: Find Your Study Spot
cards.subtitle: Case Library and Geyer Center
cards.notes: Explore five floors of resources. Find a quiet cubby or a group study room to prepare for your first week of classes.
cards.short_summary: The main university library, providing extensive print and digital collections and diverse study spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Case Library and Geyer Center for Information Technology is a five-story facility with nearly 818,000 print volumes.
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight on Sundays during the academic year; 24-hour access available during finals.

cards.title: Watch the First Sunset
cards.subtitle: A hilltop tradition for the new class
cards.notes: Gather on the hill behind Burke and Pinchin Halls. Enjoy food and music while watching the sun go down with your entire class.
cards.short_summary: A traditional orientation event where the incoming class gathers to watch the sunset from the campus hillside.
cards.evidence_claim: The First Sunset tradition involves the new class gathering on the hill behind Burke and Pinchin Halls to watch the sunset together.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled as part of the official orientation program.

cards.title: Attend Convocation
cards.subtitle: The formal welcome to the community
cards.notes: Process to the academic quad and enter the Memorial Chapel. This ceremony officially marks the beginning of your academic journey.
cards.short_summary: The capstone event of orientation that formally initiates the first-year class into the university's academic community.
cards.evidence_claim: Founders' Day Convocation is the official welcome into Colgate's academic tradition, featuring a formal procession to the Memorial Chapel.
cards.access_notes: Required for all first-year students; business casual attire is encouraged.
